about_the_game:
Empire of Lust 🏛 — Power. Pleasure. Rome.
In the heart of Ancient Rome, influence is everything — and no one knows how to climb the social ladder quite like you.

After your father’s death, you return home to inherit not just a noble house... but its secrets, debts, and pleasures. Whispers of your decadent nature follow you — and you're ready to prove them right. But this time, it’s not just for fun — it’s for power.

You throw wild, unforgettable parties, seduce the city’s elite, and build a harem of exquisite concubines — each woman more dangerous, desirable, and useful than the last. From a brilliant courtesan to a broken slave, a deadly stranger to a foreign princess — every beauty you claim unlocks new inspiration for the grandest events Rome has ever seen.

But beware: in a world of sex, politics, and betrayal, your greatest weakness might lie in the very arms that please you most.

🔥 Key Features:

🎭 Live the Roman fantasy — Step into the toga of a pleasure-loving patrician on a path to ultimate influence.
👑 Build your harem — Seduce, win, or dominate a growing collection of unique and memorable concubines.
💋 Pleasure as power — Your erotic encounters fuel your creativity and unlock new ways to grow your empire.
🏛 Manage your legacy — Throw lavish orgies, manipulate the nobility, and rise through society’s ranks.
⚔️ Lust, danger, betrayal — Every woman is a muse... or a threat. Choose wisely who to trust, tame, or punish.

Empire of Lust🏛 is a visual novel for adults who crave power, intrigue, and unapologetic pleasure — set against the backdrop of a world where indulgence isn't a sin… it’s a strategy.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains content not appropriate for all ages, or for viewing at work: sexual content, nudity. The game graphically depicts sex. All characters in the game are over the age of 18.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or above
  • Processor: Intel or AMD
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Direct X compatible
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Rise through Roman high society using charm, cunning, and carnal delight. Build a harem, throw decadent feasts, seduce the elite — and turn lust into power. In a world of pleasure and betrayal, will you conquer... or be conquered?
